pieces.Text: Your mastery of gravity gives you the ability to flow through combat with ease. Whenever you use a graviton revelation as a move action or standard action, you can take a guarded step as part of the same action. Additionally, when you take Hit Point damage, as a reaction you can use any graviton revelation you have that can be used as a move action. Once you have used a graviton revelation as a reaction with this ability, you can't do so again until you take a 10-minute rest to regain Stamina.
